name: admin-users-search
js: const q = 'mira'; const box = document.querySelector('input[type=search]'); box.value = q; box.setAttribute('value', q); document.querySelectorAll('tbody tr').forEach((e) => { if (!e.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(q)) e.remove(); }); document.querySelector('nav.pagination p').textContent = 'Showing 1–1 of 1 users'; const links = [...document.querySelectorAll('nav.pagination .pagination__link')]; links.forEach((a) => { if (a.textContent.trim().endsWith('2')) a.closest('li').remove(); }); const next = links.find((a) => a.textContent.trim().startsWith('Next')); const off = document.createElement('span'); off.className = 'pagination__link'; off.setAttribute('aria-disabled', 'true'); off.innerHTML = next.innerHTML; next.replaceWith(off); document.querySelector('caption').textContent = 'Users, page 1 of 1';
